thermal.connection: Short broad tongue from U7 tab at x=127.03,y=112 to both outer-layer spreaders, >=1.5 mm neck; avoid thermal relief on tab/vias. Reserve excludes other-net copper and subtracts actual routed obstacles. Inner1 remains GND.

reservations.name: USB MCU series resistors
reservations.constraint: Direct top-layer pad escape to MCU13/14, same lengths, no stubs; USB pair reroute required from USBLC6 to resistor1 pads; do not send pair under antenna or through power-switching loop

reservations.name: Reset latch
reservations.constraint: Local logic routed before global autorouter; 100nF decaps short direct + GND vias; sense/CT no switch-node adjacency

remove_before_move.thermal_vias: Identify only VCC3V3 thermal vias attached to old U7 islands in baseline; do not blanket-delete neighbouring GND or U6 copper
remove_before_move.tracks: Rip affected nets and moved-part pad copper as planned by root; this offline proposal does not authorize unrelated geometry deletion

limitations: Existing E_bodies packages are conservative Gerber/body estimates, not native courtyard geometry. Body plus pad union is continuously checked, including existing parts.
No track/copper DRC claim: existing routing must be removed/rebuilt on affected nets. Native footprint and clearance DRC required after application.
Thermal area is geometric reservation, not guaranteed copper after routing or thermal qualification; verify >=500mm2 combined and 6+ vias after final pours.
Local critical routes are pad-level sketches, not complete board routing; primary user prototype remains untested.
